metadata.description: Android app giving one newspaper deliverer a street-by-street overview of which addresses receive the newspaper and/or leaflets, based on mailbox stickers.

milestones.title: Preparation (plan Phase 0)
milestones.notes: Wireframes approved. Remaining: walk the real route once to note stickers and walking order (user).

milestones.title: MVP: a round can be walked (end of Phase 3)
milestones.notes: MVP complete 2026-09-30: route entry, setup wizard, round mode street by street (user approved).

milestones.title: Validated in the field (Phase 5)
milestones.notes: Two consecutive weeks without a wrong delivery caused by the app.

milestones.title: v1.0 release (Phase 7)
milestones.notes: Dutch translation review, final signed APK, limited-distribution developer verification registered before the 2027 global rollout.

features.title: Built-in updater in Settings
features.description: Settings 'Check for updates' (manual only): GitHub Releases API → compare versionCode → download APK over HTTPS → verify SHA-256 → install via PackageInstaller (DEC-024). INTERNET only for this; no background checks.
acceptance_criteria: Up to date → 'You have the latest version'
Newer release → shows version and 'Install update'; after confirming, the app updates and keeps all data
Checksum mismatch or no network → clear message, nothing installed
No network use anywhere except this button (build check)
